I saw a pack of people at the crusade meeting. I saw a flock of people at the crusade meeting. I saw a bunch of people at the crusade meeting. I saw a jury of people at the crusade meeting. I saw a congregation of peoplc at the crusade meeting. Choose Answer : - -

My friend who has just arrived from London prefers coffee than tea . Why is the underlined phrase wrong? Prefers go with 'for' instead of 'than.' Prefers go with 'to' instead of 'than.' Prefers go with 'of' instead of than.' Prefers go with 'at' instead of 'than.' Prefers go with 'in' instead of 'than.' Choose Answer : - -

Which expression describes the word "troop"? A team of lions matching together. A large group of soldiers or monkeys. A team of students performing the same task. A team of people doing a particular task. A group of hyenas hunting together. Choose Answer : - -

Our English language teacher often teaches for an hour. Why is the article 'an' is used instead of other articles? It shows time before the word 'hour'. It indicates a singular form in a sentence. The first letter in the word 'hour' has vowel qualities. The word 'hour' is in plural form. The last letter in the word 'hour' has consonant qualities. Choose Answer : - -

When it rained, she had already taken her lunch. What does this statement mean? As it rained she took her lunch. When it rained she was eating her lunch. She took her lunch when it was raining. She took her lunch earlier than it started to rain. The lunch was ready before it started to rain. Choose Answer : - -

If you combine the sentences, 'The thief died' and 'The policeman arrived', which statement shows that the two actions in the sentences happened concurrently in the past? The thief had died when the policeman arrived. The thief had had died when the policeman arrived. The policeman had had arrived when the thief had died. The policeman arrived when the thief had had died. The thief died when the policeman arrived. Choose Answer : - -

Which sentence shows that an action began at some time in the past and it is in progress at the present moment? They were playing football for the whole week. She has written many letters until now. I have been doing this work for two days. You are eating delicious food so far. My friends were drawing pictures for three days. Choose Answer : - -

Which statement is the indirect statement of 'I have moved to another flat' Juma said. Juma said that he had had moved to another flat. Juma said that he has moved to another flat. Juma said that he has already moved to another flat. Juma said that he had had already moved to another flat. Juma said that he had moved to another flat. Choose Answer : - -

How can you ask a question of which the answer is 'They can get this work done by some people?' On whom can they get this work done? By whom can they get this work done'? To whom can they get this work done? With whom can they get this work done? For whom can they get this work done? Choose Answer : - -

(iii) A gang of policemen arrived. They were carrying guns. This was frightening as (iv) a flock of people started gathering to the scene. View Ans

The use of verb "be" + "noun"
The use of verb 'be" + "adjective"
The use of verb "be" + "past participle"
The use of verb "do" + "negation" + "be" View Ans

Read the given poem and answer the questions that follow: Black woman of Africa, Women of the jungle fields, Now you cry, woman, now you lament That your child is lost. That the fire of life is no longer in him That now he is stone dead to you, You who endured for him the pain of delivery And the toil of care and growth. But you forget woman, That when he was a baby You refused him your breast, You fed him with powdered milk And gave him sugar crystals Instead of the wild honey you've always known Faked food he ate And your heart glowed To his artificial smile, And when the dirty you fed him Finally dropped out of his anus After destroying his inside, You collected the feaces with a song And held the little bundle. burning hot with life, And out you went to throw it Into the cold depths Of the toilet bowl And now your child suffers; He suffers death for the murder you committed. So you must weep and suffer with him. Poor woman of Africa. Questions : (a) With evidences, analyse three themes found in this poem. (b) Identify three poetic devices and briefly explain the intention of the poet in using those devices. View Ans
